article.title: Large number of faculty at Elite U.S. Universities linked to the National Endowment for Democracy, A CIA cut-out specializing in propaganda
article.author: Jeremy Kuzmarov
article.content: Many of the dissidents that the NED honors advocate for sanctions, bombing and war on their own countries. Some were even indicted for inciting insurrection or terrorist acts. The post Large number of faculty at Elite U.S. Universities linked to the National Endowment for Democracy, A CIA cut-out specializing in propaganda appeared first on MR Online .
